Position Description

We are seeking a Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) Engineer to join its Inspection Technology Unit (ITU) within the Inspection Technical Support Division.

The ITU is responsible for the development and deployment of advanced inspection technologies to ensure asset integrity across upstream and downstream operations. The unit focuses on qualifying and implementing innovative solutions—particularly In-Line Inspection (ILI) systems—to improve pipeline safety, reliability, and cost efficiency.

As a Non-Destructive Testing Engineer, your primary role is to lead the evaluation and implementation of NDT technologies, especially ILI systems, to enhance pipeline integrity strategies.

Duties and Responsibilities

As a successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:

  • Evaluate emerging NDT and ILI technologies
  • Provide technical guidance on application, and support their deployment across pipeline operations.
  • Oversee the technical performance of ILI tools in the field
  • Collaborate with vendors to improve data quality and tool capabilities
  • Assist in validating inspection results through field verification and integration with inspection programs.
  • Promote the adoption of advanced inspection methodologies to detect and manage critical pipeline anomalies such as corrosion, cracking, and geometry defects, ensuring alignment with safety, compliance, and operational excellence standards.

As the successful candidate you will have:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering. Advance degree is highly desirable.
  • Minimum of 20 years of professional experience in asset inspection and non-destructive testing technologies, including hands-on involvement in inline inspection operations and data interpretation.
  • NDT Level III certification in at least two inspection methods.
  • Ability to apply international codes and standards relevant to inspection operations, such as API, ASME, and AWS.
  • Ability to demonstrate a strong understanding of pipeline inspection principles, including pigging operations, pipeline cleaning, and inline inspection tool validation techniques.
  • Experience identifying and analyzing damage mechanisms detected via inline inspection, such as corrosion, stress corrosion cracking, weld anomalies, dents, and cracks.
  • Familiar with high-resolution inspection technologies used in inline tools, including magnetic flux leakage, ultrasonic testing, and electromagnetic acoustic transducer systems.
  • Capability to analyze inline inspection results and provide technical support for run/rerun decisions, dig verification campaigns, and fitness-for-service assessments.
  • Knowledge of AI and machine learning integration for predictive pipeline integrity assessments is preferred.
  • Proficiency in interpreting inspection data using advanced analytics software.
  • Ability demonstrates strong economic analysis, planning, and budgeting skills to support inspection strategy development and implementation.

Working environment

Our high-performing employees are drawn by the challenging and rewarding professional, technical and industrial opportunities we offer, and are remunerated accordingly. At Aramco, our people work on truly world-scale projects, supported by investment in capital and technology that is second to none. And because, as a global energy company, we are faced with addressing some of the world’s biggest technical, logistical and environmental challenges, we invest heavily in talent development. We have a proud history of educating and training our workforce over many decades. Employees at all levels are encouraged to improve their sector-specific knowledge and competencies through our workforce development programs – one of the largest in the world.

Aramco energizes the world economy.

Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. We are one of the world’s largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest Upstream carbon intensities of any major producer. With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco’s value to society.

Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and with offices around the world, we combine market discipline with a generations’ spanning view of the future, born of our nine decades experience as responsible stewards of the Kingdom’s vast hydrocarbon resources. This responsibility has driven us to deliver significant societal and economic benefits to not just the Kingdom, but also to a vast number of communities, economies, and countries that rely on the vital and reliable energy that we supply. We are one of the most profitable companies in the world, as well as amongst the top five global companies by market capitalization.

title: Engineer, Managing Principal
description:
Job Description

The Managing Principal Engineer (MPE) for Ship and Statutory Department is a strategic position for the ABS Rio de Janeiro Engineering Department. As ABS continues to expand its services and deliverables, this leadership role strengthens client engagement, enhances technical oversight, and streamlines departmental operations.

Responsibilities
  • Functions under the direction and oversight of a more senior Department Engineering Manager, directs and monitors project work within a technical area of a larger engineering department, and holds full responsibility for outcomes in that area.
  • Leads in their area of specialization and assigns work according to priority.
  • Acts as a technical resource and mentor to principal, senior and entry to mid-level engineers in the area of responsibility.
  • Maintains day-to-day activities, including the quality, content, consistency and continuity of all technical work performed in an assigned technical unit or area.
What You Will Do
  • Responsible for the technical verification of tasks related to ship/statutory disciplines and training new engineers in these areas.
  • Assists in the development of short- and long-range business plans and related annual operating and capital expense budgets.
  • Maintains active awareness of business and management developments affecting present and potential customers.
  • Maintains awareness of product and service capabilities of the business. Identifies improvement and developmental needs, takes action to capitalize on prospective market opportunities and makes recommendations for technology or technical tools and manpower skills necessary to implement new and improved products and services.
  • Ensures that assigned engineering positions are adequately staffed with qualified and competent personnel capable of carrying out assigned technical projects in accordance with established policies, procedures and technical standards.
  • Ensures that all ABS Quality System requirements are fulfilled with regard to project work within a technical unit or area.
  • Monitors the delivery and quality of technical services to customer satisfaction.
  • Prepares annual performance appraisals. Evaluates and communicates individual performance issues with staff under direct supervision, and recommends compensation adjustments and advancements to senior management.
  • Identifies training needs and determines appropriate training programs for developing subordinate and engineering staff members.
  • Plans and monitors ABS mandatory, required and other training needs of subordinate staff members.
  • May serve as account manager on technical projects for designated customers and actively promotes the services of ABS to clients.
  • May serve on technical or industry committees and may represent the company as a spokesperson at industry conferences or meetings.
Education and Experience
  • B.S. degree in Naval Architecture, Ocean Engineering, or Marine Engineering; an M.S. is preferred.
  • Proficiency in English commensurate with the scope of statutory certification and services; ability to communicate effectively with both laymen and experts.
  • Technical background on designing and/or reviewing different types of ships.
For those with Hull backgrounds
  • B.S. degree in Civil, Structural Engineering, Naval Architecture, Ocean Engineering, or related disciplines; an M.S. is preferred.
  • Demonstrated computer literacy in engineering software.
  • Exposure to the Finite Element Method (coursework or supervised research).
For those with Machinery backgrounds
  • B.S. degree in Marine, Mechanical, or Electrical Engineering or related disciplines; an M.S. is preferred.
Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities
  • Graduate from university with a minimum of 15 years of related industry experience.
  • B.S. degree in Naval Architecture, Ocean Engineering, or Marine Engineering; an M.S. is preferred.
  • Experience in the design and review of ship structures for offshore support vessels, tugs, pushers, and barges for rivers, intracoastal, and oceangoing services; familiarity with large merchant vessels is an asset.
  • Proficiency in conducting intact and damage stability analyses for ships and offshore structures, including freeboard calculations, verification of loading manuals, and related documentation.

Knowledge of safety arrangements requirements for ships and offshore structures based on applicable International Conventions and Regulations for a broad range of ships and floating units, including Brazilian-flagged vessels, including but not limited to Stability, Load Line, Tonnage, SOLAS, MARPOL, IBWMC, MLC, NORMAMs, etc.

Reporting Relationships

The incumbent reports directly to a Senior Managing Principal Engineer or higher. Direct reports include engineering or technical staff and office support staff of the assigned technical unit or area.

About Us

We set out more than 160 years ago to promote the security of life and property at sea and preserve the natural environment. Today, we remain true to our mission and continue to support organizations facing a rapidly evolving seascape of challenging regulations and new technologies. Our commitment to safety, reliability, and efficiency guides our clients to safer and more efficient operations.

ABS is a global leader in marine and offshore classification and other safety, quality, and environmental services. We support the global energy transition at sea, remote and autonomous marine systems, and cutting-edge technical solutions.

Equal Opportunity

ABS Bureau is committed to equal employment opportunity and prohibits discrimination based on race, color, creed, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity, age, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, citizenship status or veteran status, or other non-work-related characteristics protected by law.

Notice

ABS and Affiliated Companies (ABS) will not pay a fee to any third-party agency without a valid ABS Master Service Agreement (MSA) signed by Human Resources. Any resume or application provided without a valid MSA will be considered the property of ABS, and no fee will be paid.

Other

This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive. It reflects the principal job elements essential for fair compensation decisions.

title: Técnico de Segurança do Trabalho
description:
O Técnico de Segurança do Trabalho deve garantir a integridade física e a saúde dos colaboradores próprios e terceiros, a conformidade legal e a prevenção de acidentes nas operações de transportes e logística da DeLuna, promovendo uma cultura de segurança alinhada aos valores e metas ESG da empresa.

Requisitos
  • Curso Técnico em Segurança do Trabalho concluído. Registro/credenciamento profissional.
  • Experiência mínima de 3 anos em operações de logística, armazenagem e transportes.
  • Conhecimentos técnicos:
    • NRs aplicáveis (NR-01, 04, 05, 06, 07, 10, 11, 12, 17, 20, 23, 26, 33, 35).
    • PGR, inventário de riscos, APR, permissões de trabalho, investigação de acidentes.
    • Segurança em armazéns, docas, empilhadeiras, amarração e movimentação de cargas.
    • Noções de saúde ocupacional e eSocial.
    • Combate a incêndio e brigada; plano de emergência e simulados.
    • Ergonomia aplicada a logística e operações frigorificadas.
  • Ferramentas:
    • Pacote Office/Google e ferramentas de checklists/auditorias digitais.
    • Sistemas de gestão de SST/SESMT e eSocial.
  • Habilitações/cursos desejáveis:
    • Instrutor NR-35/NR-33, brigada de incêndio, direção defensiva.
    • Noções de ISO 45001 e ISO 14001; primeiros socorros.
    • CNH B; disponibilidade para viagens.
Competências Comportamentais
  • Foco em segurança e cuidado ativo; presença em campo.
  • Comunicação clara e didática com públicos diversos.
  • Influência e negociação para gerenciamento de mudanças.
  • Organização, senso de urgência e disciplina na gestão de planos de ação.
  • Colaboração e postura consultiva com atendimento personalizado, alinhada aos valores DeLuna.
  • Integridade, confidencialidade e respeito às pessoas.
Diferenciais
  • Vivência em operações e-commerce/last mile.
  • Experiência com gestão de transportadores terceiros e auditorias de clientes.
  • Participação em projetos de certificação e programs de cultura de segurança.
Responsabilidades e Atividades

1) Governança SST e Compliance

  • Atuar como integrante do SESMT conforme dimensionamento da NR-04.
  • Implementar e manter o PGR com inventário de riscos e plano de ação; apoiar as avaliações de exposição conforme NRs vigentes.
  • Apoiar a CIPA no dimensionamento, capacitação e cronograma anual; organizar SIPAT.
  • Gerir EPI/ EPC: especificação, distribuição, rastreabilidade, controle de vida útil e treinamentos.
  • Assegurarconformidade com NRs aplicáveis às operações DeLuna.
  • Acompanhar legislação aplicável ao transporte e logística e requisitos de clientes.

2) Operações de CDs, XPts e Transit Points

  • Realizar inspeções de rotina e emitir relatórios com planos de ação.
  • Validar layout seguro, sinalização, rotas de pedestres/empilhadeiras, proteção de estruturas, housekeeping.
  • Conduzir análises ergonômicas pontuais e propor melhorias.
  • Inspecionar sistemas de combate a incêndio e suportar brigada de incêndio;
  • Verificar condições de câmaras frias e EPIs térmicos em operações frigorificadas.

3) Transporte Rodoviário (FM/MM/LM, LH)

  • Apoiar programas de direção defensiva, análise de rotas críticas, gestão de fadiga e pausas.
  • Realizar inspeções de frota focadas em segurança.
  • Verificar documentação e treinamentos obrigatórios de motoristas e ajudantes conforme a legislação aplicável.
  • Conduzir DDS e blitz de segurança em pátios e pontos de apoio.
  • Investigar sinistros rodoviários e quase-acidentes, propondo ações corretivas e lições aprendidas.

4) Saúde Ocupacional e eSocial

  • Interface com PCMSO e Médico do Trabalho: exames admissionais, periódicos, retorno ao trabalho e mudança de função.
  • Apoiar os eventos do eSocial em conjunto com RH/DP e colaboradores.
  • Apoiar a elaboração de laudos e avaliações por profissionais legalmente habilitados, providenciando dados e acompanhando planos de ação.

5) Treinamentos, Cultura e Comunicação

  • Planejar, ministrar e/ou coordenar treinamentos obrigatórios e específicos.
  • Gerenciar a matriz de capacitação, controles de validade e reciclagens; garantir 100% de aderência.
  • Conduzir campanhas e comunicações de segurança, reforçando os valores e a cultura DeLuna.

6) Emergências e Preparação/Resposta

  • Manter plano de emergência atualizado: cenários em armazéns, câmaras frias, incêndio, vazamento de combustíveis, sinistros rodoviários.
  • Realizar simulados periódicos com brigada e times operacionais; alinhar com corpo de bombeiros e contratadas.
  • Garantir kits de emergência, fichas de segurança e contatos úteis disponíveis e atualizados.

7) Gestão de Terceiros e Fornecedores

  • Qualificar, auditar e acompanhar prestadores sob critérios de SST; verificar documentos, treinamentos e indicadores.
  • Incluir requisitos de SST em contratos e SLAs em parceria com Suprimentos e Jurídico.
  • Acompanhar execução de manutenção predial e de equipamentos por terceiros com Permissão de Trabalho quando aplicável.

8) ESG e Melhoria Contínua

  • Contribuir para metas ESG.
  • Apoiar auditorias internas/externas e requisitos de clientes;
  • Liderar investigação de incidentes com metodologia estruturada e garantir a eficácia das ações.

title: Training Site Infrastructure Manager FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027TM
description:
FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 (“FWWC2027”).

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Job Description

The position

The Training Site Infrastructure Manager reports to the FWWC27 Head of Infrastructure and Technical Services and FIFA Training Sites Manager, serving as a key member of the FIFA27 Tournament Infrastructure team in close collaboration with the Team Services, Team Facilities team and other stakeholders.
The successful candidate will ensure all deliverables align with FIFA’s exacting standards while optimizing operational efficiency and stakeholder satisfaction.

This position plays a pivotal role in the planning, development, and delivery of infrastructure at FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 training sites across Brazil. Working alongside the FIFA Training Site Manager and in coordination with Team Services, Technical Services, Pitch Management, Venue Design, Dressing & Signage, Media Operations, Partnerships and external stakeholders (Training Site Authorities and Football Clubs), the role is responsible for ensuring all training sites are operationally ready and compliant with FIFA’s requirements and standards.

The ideal candidate brings a strong background in architectural and interior design, technical project management, stakeholder coordination, and large-scale international event delivery. As demonstrated through global events such as FIFA World Cups and Olympic Games. They will manage the implementation of training site upgrades, including renovations, overlays, and delivery of essential infrastructure, with a focus on strategic planning, design integration, and resource optimization.

Key responsibilities
  • Lead the design and infrastructure delivery strategy for all FWWC2027 training sites, incorporating best practices in venue planning, design management, and stakeholder engagement.
  • Coordinate the implementation of renovations and upgrades, overseeing construction quality, progress, and alignment with FIFA’s requirements and standards.
  • Manage the end-to-end lifecycle of overlay and technical service delivery, including scope definition, scheduling, procurement, installation, and handover.
  • Engage with Training Site Authorities, contractors, and internal teams to ensure seamless collaboration and delivery.
  • Implement project controls for budgeting, reporting, and risk mitigation.
  • Ensure sustainability, cultural alignment, and aesthetic quality across all training site environments.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams such as Pitch Management, Cleaning & Waste, Venue Design, and Dressing & Signage to ensure cohesive delivery.

Your profile

  • 10+ years of experience in architectural design, project management, and delivery of international sporting event infrastructure.
  • Proven track record in managing venue delivery and readiness, overlay operations, or major venue infrastructure for events like FIFA World Cup or Olympics.
  • Strong technical expertise in space planning, stakeholder communication, and procurement processes.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Project Management, Architecture, Interior Design, Engineering, or related field.
  • Proficiency in AutoCAD, BIM 360, MS Project, and other project management tools.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess and implement effective solutions.
  • Excellent negotiation and contract management skills.
  • Driver’s license
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.
About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

Engineering Manager - Solutions Engineering

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We want to transform the world of software operations by enabling true model-driven operations via next-generation infrastructure-as-code. This will allow companies to run very efficient bare-metal operations for high-performance computing, private cloud, data lakes, AI/ML, and analytics. We need to invent some new technology, and we need to build some new products; we are therefore looking for someone who can lead and inspire a regional software engineering team to fulfill this initiative.

The Solutions Engineering team works in close collaboration with our managed infrastructure operations team, which runs many private OpenStack clouds and Kubernetes clusters for customers around the world. This enables us to improve our infra-as-code products based on our own real experience, mirroring that of our users and customers. We work in Python, creating open-source automation capabilities that simplify operations for anybody, anywhere, who is building on Ubuntu.

Most of the team's work involves pure Python software development focused on enabling true DevOps workflows. We strive for high quality in both design, documentation, tests, and performance as we enhance operations code packages and Ubuntu itself in order to ensure our platform is the easiest, most robust, and best performing for driving your infrastructure.

As an Engineering Manager, your primary responsibility is to the people you lead and support: ensuring that they are growing as engineers, doing valuable work, and finding satisfaction in their career at Canonical. We need someone who can display technical leadership by leveraging a solid background in software development so that they're able to challenge and grow their team members. You will have the opportunity to influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on direction and execution.

What you will do

  • Lead and develop a team of Python engineers working remotely in global locations
  • Hiring, coaching, mentoring, feedback, and hands-on career development
  • Demonstrate sound engineering principles by directly contributing code yourself
  • Plan and manage progress on agreed goals and projects
  • Set and manage expectations with other engineering and operations teams
  • Coordinate with management and internal and external stakeholders or customers
  • Advocate for modern, agile software development practices
  • Help develop and evangelize great engineering and organizational practices
  • Grow a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with the company values
  • Be an active part of the leadership team and collaborate with other leaders in the organisation
  • Travel globally up to 10% of time for internal and external events

Who you are

  • You love developing and growing people and have a track record of doing it
  • You are knowledgeable and passionate about agile software development
  • You love leading, coaching, and mentoring software developers - especially Python ones
  • You are knowledgeable in cloud computing concepts & technologies
  • You are comfortable administrating Linux servers, including their storage and networking
  • You have hands-on experience with software automation
  • You are organized and want your team to deliver high-quality software in a timely manner
  • You are a lifelong learner

Bonus points for

  • You have graduated with a university degree in Computer Science or related software engineering field
  • Having a thorough understanding of modern infrastructure, including OpenStack or Kubernetes
  • Having experience in operations as well as software development
  • Being familiar with the challenges of large-scale, multi-cloud operations
  • Go expertise

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

description:

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring an Engineering Manager for Ceph & Distributed Storage. The world creates more than 2.5 quintillion bytes of data every day! We want to help teams to store data in open source storage on commodity hardware - safely, cheaply and simply.

Our goal is to make Ceph easy to install, manage and use - from large enterprise data center installations to half-rack edge sites. We believe that distributed storage shouldn't be hard - and to keep up with the increasing data storage demands, it needs to be easier than ever before. We have a range of tools to bring to bear on the problem, and we're excited to make distributed Ceph easy enough that everyone does it.

As an engineering manager at Canonical you must be technically strong, but your responsibility is to run an effective team and develop the colleagues you manage. You are expected to help them grow as engineers, do important work, do it outstandingly well, find professional and personal satisfaction, and work well with colleagues and community. Technical leadership experience and a background in software engineering are necessary prerequisites for this role. You will be expected to lead, challenge, and develop strong engineers, positively influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution. You will be responsible for sound software architecture and best practices in software quality, testing and documentation.

What you'll do

  • You will lead a team building a Ceph focused software defined storage solution
  • You will build and manage a globally distributed team of engineers
  • You'll develop your team through coaching, mentoring and feedback
  • You will demonstrate sound engineering principles by directly contributing toward your team's goals
  • Set reasonable schedules based on considered estimates, with feedback loops for improvement
  • Set and manage expectations with other engineering teams and external stakeholders
  • Advance modern, agile software development practices
  • Maintain a culture of quality and engineering excellence
  • Grow a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with the company values
  • Be an active part of the leadership team and collaborate with other leaders in the organisation
  • Work from home with global travel up to 20% for internal and external events

Who you are

  • You have a software engineering background, preferably with Python and C++ experience
  • You have experience operating scale out storage clusters on Linux in production environments, preferably with Ceph
  • You love embracing new technologies and pushing the boundaries of what is possibleYou love developing and growing people and have a track record of doing it
  • You have an interest in building products that improve how people operate software and infrastructure everywhere
  • You are knowledgeable and passionate about software development
  • You have experience in leading, managing, coaching and mentoring software developers towards delivering timely, high quality software together
  • You have solid experience working in an agile development environment

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

description:
Empresa empregadora TotalEnergies EP Brasil Ltda

Tipo de contrato Contrato Duração Indeterminada (CDI)

Experiência Mínimo 6 anos

Context & Environment

Subsidiária recém-produtora com fases de exploração, avaliação e desenvolvimento em ativos operados. Os projetos estão predominantemente em LAPA (produção, projetos e perfuração de avaliação) e C-M-541 (perfuração exploratória com potencial para avançar para perfuração de avaliação).

  • Ambiente de alto custo com regulamentações locais rigorosas.
  • Contexto de águas profundas / ultra-profundas.
  • Poços exploratórios (ambiente sensível e remoto).
  • Assunção de uma instalação existente operada por terceiros.
  • Assistência contratual a ativos operados por terceiros (OBO – Operated by Others).
  • Alto nível de riscos técnicos devido aos custos operacionais.
  • Alto nível de objetivos de desempenho.
  • Trabalho em equipe dentro de uma estrutura enxuta.
  • Relacionamento com autoridades estaduais/reguladores, se aplicável.

O titular do cargo atua em um ambiente multidisciplinar de contratos e compras (exploração, perfuração, desenvolvimento, trabalho no mar e em terra) em um ambiente internacional e ambiente de conteúdo local simultaneamente.

A falta ou entrega tardia de materiais ou serviços, independentemente de seu valor, pode ter consequências importantes na produção e nas finanças.

Atividades

O(a) colaborador(a) deverá desempenhar suas atividades em conformidade com o Sistema de Gestão de HSE (Saúde, Segurança e Meio Ambiente), alinhado aos Princípios do One Maestro e orientado para salvaguardar a integridade das pessoas, tendo em mente a preservação do meio ambiente e dos recursos, contribuindo para melhorar a eficiência energética e a descarbonização dos ativos da Empresa, bem como sua reputação.

As principais atividades do titular do cargo são:

  • Supervisionar o estabelecimento dos contratos, participando diretamente dos contratos e pedidos de compra mais complexos.
  • Validar ou garantir a validação de todos os documentos contratuais e cartas formais emitidas pela área de contratos e compras.
  • Participar de auditorias contratuais seletivas para garantir o cumprimento dos termos e condições contratuais.
  • Intervir na resolução de litígios, em conjunto com as áreas Jurídica, Seguros e Financeira, propondo estratégias e ações, e participando das negociações.
  • Definir e monitorar indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) para garantir a melhoria da eficiência.
  • Manter atualizados os conteúdos locais dos modelos de contrato (condições gerais e particulares), e adaptar versões internacionais às exigências locais.
  • Garantir o reporte global da equipe de Contratos e Compras à gestão da SCLC.
  • Definir, adotar e monitorar estratégias de contratação e compras adequadas (por categorias, etc.).
  • Promover uma cultura de melhoria contínua, sendo responsável por garantir o compartilhamento de lições aprendidas e boas práticas, não apenas com a SCLC, mas também com outras áreas da Empresa.
  • Realizar todas as atividades de contratação em conformidade com as políticas e procedimentos da Empresa e com a legislação brasileira.
  • Definir a estratégia de contratação em conjunto com o(a) contraparte do “Dueto” para atender e proteger os melhores interesses comerciais da Empresa.
  • Propor, pré-qualificar e recomendar contratantes/fornecedores adequados para listas de licitação, visando maximizar a eficiência dos processos de concorrência.
  • Compilar, emitir e administrar pacotes de “Convite para Licitação” para obter propostas realistas e comercialmente atrativas de potenciais contratantes/fornecedores. (Isso inclui revisar e compilar a parte técnica do pacote de licitação com base nas informações recebidas dos técnicos e fornecer aconselhamento comercial relevante).
  • Redigir termos e condições contratuais e comerciais apropriados para melhor atender e proteger os interesses da Empresa.
  • Revisar propostas, participar de esclarecimentos e negociações contratuais e comerciais, preparar todos os documentos associados, como apresentações, atas de reuniões, registro de qualificações contratuais e comerciais, minuta de recomendação de adjudicação, finalizar o contrato, administrar a adjudicação de contratos, ordens de mudança/variação, aditivos contratuais, reivindicações e toda a correspondência associada.
  • Revisar e considerar os aspectos legais associados à adjudicação e administração de contratos, em articulação com o Departamento Jurídico, fornecendo aconselhamento aos clientes conforme apropriado e auxiliando, quando necessário, na resolução de litígios.
  • Arquivar a documentação contratual e correspondências de forma lógica, organizada e auditável.
  • Participar da aprovação externa (Parceiros), revisando os boletins com as informações relevantes de C&P.
  • Garantir que todos os certificados contratuais, garantias, cauções e seguros exigidos no portfólio de contratos estejam em vigor dentro do prazo.
  • Facilitar reuniões necessárias para a condução das atividades do cargo.
  • Apoiar a equipe de Ativos Operados por Terceiros (OBO), participando de apresentações do Operador e assessorando nos aspectos contratuais e comerciais.

O titular do cargo gerencia a Conformidade:

  • Verificar que as Políticas de Contratos e Compras da empresa e as leis e regulamentos aplicáveis estão sendo seguidos, especialmente no que diz respeito à ética e transparência.
  • Verificar que os documentos e procedimentos de compras estão em conformidade com os padrões da empresa e com os acordos firmados com os parceiros.
  • Garantir a aplicação e o respeito aos procedimentos durante o processo de licitação.
  • Assegurar a aplicação das Condições Gerais de Compra da TEPBR, especialmente no que diz respeito a equipamentos complexos, de alto valor e alto risco.

O titular do cargo segue as regras de H3SE:

  • Servir como exemplo pessoal na adesão aos procedimentos de HSE da TEPBR.
  • Promover conscientização e fornecer orientação aos colaboradores sob sua supervisão quanto à execução das regras de HSE, tanto para funcionários da Empresa quanto para fornecedores, sem prejudicar as obrigações legais do Contratado.
  • Assegurar, para si e para os colaboradores sob sua supervisão, a segurança do ambiente de trabalho, evitando riscos às pessoas, às instalações e impactos ao meio ambiente.
  • Manter os meios de proteção individual e os procedimentos de emergência de segurança.
  • Realizar inspeções regulares e reportar quaisquer incidentes (anomalias, atos inseguros, quase acidentes, danos, derramamentos, lesões, etc.).
  • Notificar os colaboradores relevantes sobre acidentes, incidentes e quase acidentes, e iniciar ações corretivas.

Responsabilidades:

  • Preparar, negociar, adjudicar e administrar contratos/pedidos de compra de obras, bens e serviços de forma a garantir que os melhores interesses comerciais da Empresa sejam atendidos e protegidos.
  • Conduzir o trabalho de maneira a otimizar o desempenho em HSEQ (Saúde, Segurança, Meio Ambiente e Qualidade), a reputação e a lucratividade da Empresa, em estrita conformidade com os mais altos padrões de ética empresarial.
  • Estar em conformidade com os requisitos do Sistema de Gestão da Empresa (CMS) aplicáveis ao cargo, reportando quaisquer não conformidades à gestão direta.

O titular do cargo deverá garantir que:

  • As regras da Empresa sejam seguidas ou devidamente justificadas em caso de exceção.
  • As Especificações Gerais, Diretrizes e Manuais sejam considerados.
  • Os indicadores e KPIs sejam observados, monitorados e devidamente reportados.
  • Os objetivos de desempenho e eficiência de custos em Contratos e Compras sejam cumpridos.
  • O conhecimento técnico em Contratos e Compras seja compartilhado dentro do grupo TotalEnergies.
  • Sejam buscadas oportunidades de redução de custos e aumento de eficiência.
Perfil do Candidato

Competências de C&P (Contratos e Compras):

  • Competências técnicas avançadas em contratos e compras são exigidas.
  • Nível intermediário-avançado nas demais competências técnicas.

Qualificação e Experiência:

  • Formação superior (nível universitário ou acima).
  • Conhecimento e compreensão dos processos de compras, incluindo: princípios éticos; pré-qualificação de licitantes; convite para licitação; avaliação comparativa de contratantes; adjudicação, gestão de reivindicações, administração, alteração e encerramento de contratos.
  • Pelo menos 5 anos de experiência prática na preparação, negociação e administração de contratos de projetos complexos, preferencialmente na indústria de petróleo offshore.
  • Conhecimento profissional demonstrável e compreensão de questões comerciais, jurídicas e de seguros que afetam a empresa em geral, e compreensão aprofundada quando relevante para contratos de obras, bens e serviços.
  • Conhecimento geral e compreensão das funções empresariais da empresa, com entendimento aprofundado da função de contratos e de como ela agrega valor, além de compromisso em entregar valor agregado.
  • Deve ter proficiência em inglês e fluência em português.

Join to apply for the Cloud Field Engineering Manager role at Canonical

This is an opportunity to run a field engineering team, helping customers understand and implement Canonical's open source solutions in public clouds and in their own data centers. We work across the entire spectrum of cloud offerings, from Ubuntu itself to virtualisation and private cloud, Kubernetes, and the implementation of sophisticated open source solutions such as MLops platforms, data platforms and more. We are rapidly expanding the range of open source solutions we offer and deliver to customers, as we move into new industries like telco, finance, health care and media we design and develop new open source solutions to meet their needs.

We believe that Engineering Managers should be outstanding engineers themselves. They should feel completely at home troubleshooting technical issues and having technical presales conversations with customers. They should contribute to project delivery themselves, but know that the technical contributions they bring are far less significant than their ability to shape the whole team's direction, focus and delivery. We grow management skills and train engineers, who are interested in soft skills, to be managers.

We believe that open source is just starting to transform the tech sector and enterprise compute. Our goal is to make open source easier, more reliable and more secure for deployment and development. We strive to be the provider of 'most software to most companies'. To deliver on that ambition, our engineers are carefully selected from the applicants across the globe. We select for brilliance and motivation to take open source to the next level. Our engineering managers help teams achieve more than they realised they could, and feel proud of the result.

The role of a Cloud Field Engineering Manager at Canonical

The Field Engineering team is our team of cloud solutions architects at Canonical, working directly with our customers, designing private and public cloud solutions fitting their workload needs. The portfolio of products includes on-premise cloud solutions such as Openstack, MicroCloud and Ceph, and solutions that could be deployed either on-premises or in public clouds such as Kubernetes, Kubeflow, Spark, PostgreSQL, etc. The team works hands-on with the technologies by deploying, testing and handing over the solution to our support or managed services team at the end of a project. Managers and team members also take part in presales conversations to provide technical advice during the sales process.

A Cloud Field Engineering Manager is responsible for line management and career guidance. The ability to develop engineering talent, to represent your team from a technical perspective, and to drive collaboration with other teams and customers are all critical to success in this role. You are also expected to actively participate in technical presales to help our department achieve our quarterly goals.

Location: This role will be home based, managing a team in your time zone.

What your day will look like

  • Lead and develop a team of Field engineers, ranging from graduate to senior, in the areas of Presales and Professional Services
  • Solve customer problems by promoting our technologies and being a trusted advisor
  • Work remotely in a single major time zone
  • Coach, mentor, and offer career development feedback
  • Identify and measure team health indicators
  • Implement disciplined engineering processes
  • Represent your team and product to stakeholders, partners, and customers
  • Develop and evangelise great engineering and organisational practices
  • Plan and manage progress on agreed goals and projects
  • Be an active part of the leadership team, collaborating with other leaders

What we are looking for in you

  • Knowledge of cloud computing concepts & technologies, such as Kubernetes, Openstack, AWS, GCP, Azure, Ceph, etc.
  • Practical knowledge of Linux and networking
  • Experience in technical presales
  • You are a dynamic person who loves to jump in new projects and interact with people
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English
  • Passion and a track record of developing and growing people
  • Experience in leading, coaching and mentoring engineers
  • Organised and able to ensure your team delivers timely, high quality results
  • An exceptional academic track record from high school and, preferably, university as well
  • Willingness to travel up to 40% of the time. Field Engineers attend internal company events, external tech events and customer meetings.

Additional skills that you might also bring

  • Second language - Spanish or French preferred
  • Python knowledge
  • Experience collaborating with external partners
  • Experience collaborating with several internal teams and providing stakeholder feedback for engineering roadmaps

What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues from your team and others
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.

Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Descrição da empresa

Quer trabalhar na maior plataforma de saúde do MUNDO ?

Somos a Doctoralia , empresa do grupo Docplanner , e estamos presentes em 13 países , sendo responsáveis por atender mais de 55 milhões de pacientes e processar mais de 17 milhões de agendamentos de consultas por mês!
Atualmente, temos mais de 2 milhões de profissionais da saúde em nossa base, somando aproximadamente 14 milhões de avaliações de pacientes até hoje.

Nossa missão é “Ajudar as pessoas a viverem vidas mais longas e saudáveis”.

Através de uma diversificada gama de serviços, conseguimos atender a diferentes públicos : marketplace , que permite que pacientes agendem e avaliem consultas e médicos a qualquer hora do dia ou da noite; e sistema SaaS (Software as a Service) voltado para otimização da gestão do consultório , fluxo de pacientes e realização de consultas online . Tudo isso através de plataforma na internet ou aplicativo para iOS ou Android.

Descrição da vaga

Estamos contratando um Líder de Onboarding para liderar e otimizar os primeiros 45 dias da jornada dos nossos clientes (clínicas com 1 ou 2 usuários). Você será responsável por um time focado em impulsionar a ativação, adoção e tempo até o valor percebido — garantindo que essas clínicas implementem com sucesso o sistema da Feegow, compreendam suas funcionalidades principais e se mantenham engajadas nas primeiras semanas críticas de adoção.

Principais Responsabilidades
  • Liderar o time de onboarding responsável pelas clínicas pequenas, garantindo um processo estruturado, próximo e escalável.
  • Ser dono dos principais indicadores da área: ativação, adoção, churn precoce e tempo até o primeiro valor.
  • Definir, documentar e iterar o playbook de onboarding para esse segmento.
  • Desenvolver e aplicar treinamentos de produto para elevar o conhecimento técnico do time.
  • Colaborar com os times de Produto, Suporte e Expansão para identificar fricções e oportunidades de melhoria.
  • Atuar como liderança prática: apoiar o time em onboardings complexos quando necessário.
Qualificações
  • Experiência em Onboarding ou Implementação em empresas SaaS
  • Experiência em liderança ou coordenação com gestão de pessoas
  • Vivência com gestão de KPIs e funis de onboarding: SLA, Scorings, Early Churn
  • Capacidade de desenhar processos e especialmente seguir processos
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de CRM: Hubspot ou Salesforce
  • Inglês - Médio a avancado

Aqui na DOC, valorizamos e celebramos a diversidade em todas as suas formas. Estamos empenhados em atrair talentos diversos, sem importar gênero, raça, orientação sexual, religião, nacionalidade, idade ou condição física. Buscamos um(a) Especialista em suporte de infraestrutura para atuar na área de backoffice de sistemas de uma grande empresa, de forma operacional, para apoio à manutenção dos sistemas atuais.

Deve atuar em um papel técnico de Sysadmin de Aplicações, ter paixão por garantir a estabilidade de sistemas críticos e gosta de atuar nos bastidores da tecnologia. Procuramos alguém com autonomia, que seja capaz de diagnosticar e resolver problemas de forma prática (hands-on), garantindo a performance, disponibilidade e segurança das nossas plataformas.

Como será seu dia a dia:

  • Você será o principal responsável pela saúde e estabilidade dos servidores que hospedam nossas aplicações de backoffice, principalmente o Protheus e Fluig;
  • Planejará e executará a atualização de versões (releases) e a aplicação de patches tanto dos sistemas quanto dos servidores (Windows/Linux);
  • Seu foco será nos elementos não-funcionais: irá gerenciar a performance, disponibilidade e segurança da plataforma, garantindo que os sistemas operem com eficiência;
  • Cuidará de toda a camada de integração entre os sistemas da plataforma e outras aplicações, solucionando problemas de comunicação e conectividade;
  • Realizará a instalação e configuração de novas instâncias dos sistemas, desde o download do instalador até a entrega do environment para a equipe funcional;
  • Colaborará intensamente com outras equipes técnicas de TI (Infraestrutura, Redes, Segurança) para resolver problemas complexos e implementar melhorias;
  • Terá autonomia para diagnosticar e resolver incidentes de forma prática (hands-on), indo além de simplesmente acionar fornecedores externos.

Requisitos Obrigatórios:

  • Experiência sólida como Administrador de Sistemas, Analista de Infraestrutura ou em uma função similar com foco em sustentação de aplicações;
  • Profundo conhecimento em administração de servidores em ambientes Windows Server e Linux;
  • Conhecimento robusto de conceitos de infraestrutura de TI: redes (TCP/IP, DNS), firewalls, gerenciamento de portas de comunicação e Active Directory (Domínios);
  • Experiência prática com o processo de instalação, configuração e atualização de sistemas de software em ambiente de servidor;
  • Perfil proativo, com autonomia para investigação e resolução de problemas técnicos complexos;
  • Excelente habilidade de comunicação para interagir com equipes técnicas dentro do departamento de TI.

Requisitos Desejáveis:

  • Experiência prévia na administração das plataformas TOTVS Protheus e/ou Fluig;
  • Vivência com a administração de outros sistemas ERP ou plataformas de backoffice;
  • Conhecimento em automação de rotinas e scripting (PowerShell, Shell Script);
  • Noções de ambientes em nuvem (Azure, AWS) e plataformas de virtualização (VMware, Hyper-V);
  • Conhecimento sobre o funcionamento de APIs REST/SOAP para análise e solução de problemas de integração;
  • Experiência com a gestão de servidores de banco de dados (SQL Server, Oracle etc.).

That’s why we cover the entire supply chain with unparalleled breadth and depth, backed by over 50 years’ experience. Our team of over 2,400 experts, operating across 30 global locations, are enabling customers’ decisions through real-time analytics, consultancy, events and thought leadership. Together, we deliver the insight they need to separate risk from opportunity and make confident decisions when it matters most.**Wood Mackenzie Values*** Inclusive – we succeed together* Trusting – we choose to trust each other* Customer committed – we put customers at the heart of our decisions* Future Focused – we accelerate change* Curious – we turn knowledge into action**Role Purpose**Establishing resilient, sustainable and reliable portfolios is critical to energy companies as they develop agile business models to navigate the Energy Transition. We strive to be the partner of choice in offering a range of world-class products and services to support the business needs of these companies. Our global Subsurface Research Team delivers integrated research, data analysis and industry-leading thought leadership, across the geo-energy landscape, enabling customers to make quicker, more effective decisions.The scope, integrity and connectivity of our Subsurface dataset are foundational to our goal of delivering the market’s leading Subsurface solution. Additionally, the integration of high quality technical and commercial data is critical to enabling our customers to execute high value workflows and deliver data-driven insights to inform investment decisions for the Energy Transition. Reporting into our Subsurface Research Leadership, an experienced, highly motivated, innovative and performance oriented Senior Analyst is required to ensure analytics readiness, across our Subsurface dataset, for the Americas region.**Main Responsibilities*** Work with the Upstream data function, Subsurface research analysts and the regional Upstream research teams, to ensure delivery of the Subsurface data expansion plan, including meeting agreed data coverage, completeness, integrity and timing OKRs – warranting that all options to deliver the plan have been explored / utilised* Work with Subsurface research analysts, and the Upstream product function, to ensure seamless connectivity (e.g. across basins, plays, prospects, wells and field reservoirs) of our Subsurface dataset* Ensure the that our Subsurface dataset is analytics ready for customers. Collaborate with our Upstream regional research teams to affect a cultural shift in Subsurface data accountability* Support the delivery of our Subsurface Value Creation Plan roadmap through deep participation in, and collaboration across, the associated workstreams* Build and develop a strong relationship network with our customers. Engage to understand their use cases, workflows, pain points and data needs in support of the continuous improvement of our offer* Help to build organisational capability within the data function through teaching, coaching and advising less experienced staff in support of Subsurface data excellence* Support the Subsurface team’s vision and agenda and be a positive advocate for Wood Mackenzie’s brand* Embrace, practise and demonstrate Wood Mackenzie’s core values on teamwork and collaboration, respect, integrity, fairness and valuing diversity**About You**You are passionate about the energy sector and the role it plays in delivering energy to the world. You have a curious and analytical mindset, understand the power of Subsurface data, and excited by the potential of AI across the Upstream value chain. You are passionate about performance excellence and able to analyse and form clear, coherent conclusions from a variety of data and information. You find it easy communicating complex or technical information and delivering messages that are easily understood.You thrive in a collaborative, commercial and client-centric environment and proven track record of fostering strong working relationships through coaching, influencing and developing others around you. The people around you recognise your ability to develop others and build an environment in which people thrive and deliver high quality resultsThe way in which you work is productive and driven, striving to be best in class. You share ideas and take accountability. The way in which you work enables you to build strong, collaborative internal relationships and influence stakeholders at all levels of the wider organization. You understand that diversity of experience and thought is important and that working across different geographies requires cultural appreciation.If you are looking for a role where you can be part of a dynamic team, that is supporting clients to make better informed decisions, and influence how we power our planet, apply now**.****Qualifications and Capabilities*** Minimum of a BSc in a Geoscience discipline; a data science qualification would be an advantage.* 5-10 years of Subsurface experience within the Upstream sector with a strong understanding of the petroleum geology of the Americas and deep exposure to common Subsurface use cases, workflows and data usage.* Demonstrable data analytical skills and experience of working with databases.* Up-to-date knowledge of the utilisation of AI across the Upstream Subsurface space.* Experience in external relationship building and management.* Strong commercial acumen.* Demonstrable curiosity with a track record of impactful innovation.* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.* A track record in demonstrating differentiated values and behaviours with a particular focus on teamwork and collaboration.**Expectations*** We are a hybrid working company and the successful applicant will be required to be physically present in the office at least 2 days per week to foster and contribute to a collaborative environment. Job description

Somos a Conexa , ecossistema digital de saúde integral, líder na América Latina . Contamos com milhares de médicos, psicólogos, nutricionistas e enfermeiros que, por meio de nossa plataforma, conseguem cuidar de pacientes em qualquer lugar que eles estejam. Unimos pacientes, profissionais, empresas e operadoras com o objetivo de reduzir as ineficiências de custo e qualidade de atendimento do sistema de saúde brasileiro.

A Conexa está revolucionando o acesso à saúde e, para continuarmos crescendo de forma sustentável e eficiente, estamos em busca de uma liderança estratégica para a nossa área de Performance e Planejamento.

A sua missão será construir e liderar o processo de Planejamento Integrado de Saúde (S&OP), conectando as áreas de Growth, Operações Assistenciais, Negócios e Finanças. Você será a pessoa responsável por garantir que nossa capacidade de atendimento e nossa demanda de pacientes estejam perfeitamente equilibradas, otimizando a utilização de nossos recursos, reduzindo custos e, o mais importante, garantindo a melhor experiência para nossos pacientes.

Se você é apaixonado por dados, obcecado por eficiência e tem experiência em construir processos de planejamento do zero, esta é a sua oportunidade de deixar uma marca profunda em uma empresa de alto crescimento.

Aviso importante!

A Conexa nunca cobra qualquer valor para participação em seus processos seletivos. Todas as nossas vagas são divulgadas exclusivamente pela Gupy e o processo de inscrição é totalmente gratuito . Caso receba qualquer pedido de pagamento ou oferta de vaga fora da Gupy, desconfie! Isso não faz parte da nossa prática de recrutamento.

Main responsibilities

Você será responsável por:

  • Estruturar e Liderar o Processo de S&OP: Desenhar e implementar o ciclo de planejamento integrado da companhia, definindo cadências (semanais, mensais, trimestrais), rituais e fóruns para tomada de decisão colaborativa entre as áreas.
  • Gestão de Capacidade vs. Demanda: Analisar profundamente nossa capacidade médica (oferta) versus a previsão de demanda, identificando ociosidade, gargalos e oportunidades de otimização para garantir a máxima taxa de ocupação e o menor custo por consulta.
  • Ownership do Forecast: Assumir a responsabilidade pelo processo de previsão de demanda, trabalhando em parceria com a área de Growth para medir, desafiar e calibrar os modelos, garantindo alta acurácia e visibilidade de curto, médio e longo prazo.
  • Fomentar a Cultura de Dados: Padronizar e governar os principais KPIs da operação (ex.: taxa de ocupação, custo por consulta, no-show), desenvolvendo dashboards e relatórios que tragam transparência e embasem todas as decisões estratégicas.
  • Análise de Custos e Interface com Finanças: Atuar como um parceiro estratégico do time Financeiro, analisando as variações de custo assistencial, apoiando a estruturação dos processos de pagamento e garantindo a saúde financeira da operação.
  • Liderança e Desenvolvimento de Time: Liderar, mentorar e desenvolver a equipe de analistas de performance, transformando a área em um centro de excelência técnica e estratégica dentro da companhia.
Requirements and skills

Esperamos de você:

  • Sólida experiência em áreas de Planejamento (S&OP, IBP, FP&A), Business Intelligence ou Planejamento Estratégico.
  • Experiência comprovada em liderança e gestão de equipes.
  • Forte habilidade analítica e quantitativa, com domínio em ferramentas de análise e visualização de dados (SQL, Power BI, Tableau, Looker ou similar).
  • Experiência com modelagem de dados, forecasting e análise de cenários.
  • Excelente habilidade de comunicação e gestão de stakeholders, com capacidade de influenciar líderes de diferentes áreas.
  • Conhecimentos que te destacam:
  • Experiência no setor de saúde, healthtechs ou empresas de tecnologia com operações complexas (marketplaces, logística etc.).
  • Conhecimento em linguagens de programação para análise de dados (Python ou R).
  • Experiência em projetos de otimização de custos e eficiência operacional.

Nós já fazemos parte do seu dia. Agora, queremos que você faça parte do nosso dia a dia!

Traga a sua energia para a Light!

As a Data & Telemetry Architect , you will design, implement, and manage telemetry systems crucial for enhancing telecommunications operations. You will utilize technical proficiency in Splunk, ELK Stack, Grafana, and distributed tracing solutions to create insightful telemetry and observability platforms that significantly impact network performance, service assurance, and security.

How your day-to-day work will look like:

  • Design, implement, and manage telemetry systems to enhance telecommunications operations.
  • Develop and optimize telemetry and observability platforms using tools like Splunk, ELK Stack, Grafana, and distributed tracing solutions.
  • Ensure network performance, service assurance, and security through advanced telemetry strategies.

This would make you the ideal candidate:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 5+ Years of experience in Data Architecture, including designing robust data models (e.g., Splunk CIM, star/snowflake schemas) and data governance frameworks tailored to large-scale, high-volume telemetry data (preferably within telecommunications).
  • 3+ Years of hands-on experience in at least two of the following observability platforms:
  • Splunk (including Splunk Search Processing Language – SPL, and Common Information Model – CIM).
  • Grafana and Prometheus for implementing observability solutions.
  • 2+ Years of strong scripting skills (e.g., Python, Bash, PowerShell) for automation of telemetry system deployment, configuration management, and operational tasks.
  • Experience designing and implementing observability solutions with audit trails for user/system activities.
  • Familiarity with distributed tracing concepts and tools (e.g., OpenTelemetry, Grafana Tempo, Jaeger).
  • Understanding of telco network architectures (4G/LTE, 5G) and common data sources (CDRs, IPDRs, signaling data).
  • Proven experience designing scalable observability systems in telco or high-throughput environments.
  • Knowledge of security best practices for telemetry platforms (data encryption, RBAC).
  • Experience with cloud environments (AWS, Azure or GCP) and native cloud monitoring tools (CloudWatch, Azure Monitor or Google Operations Suite).
  • Experience designing and implementing data warehousing or data lake solutions for high-volume telemetry data.
  • Advanced English Level is required for this role as you will work with US clients. Effective communication in English is essential to deliver the best solutions to our clients and expand your horizons.

description:
Join to apply for the Customer Success Manager (Brazil) role at SecurityScorecard

Join to apply for the Customer Success Manager (Brazil) role at SecurityScorecard

SecurityScorecard is the global leader in cybersecurity ratings, with over 12 million companies continuously rated, operating in 64 countries. Founded in 2013 by security and risk experts Dr. Alex Yampolskiy and Sam Kassoumeh and funded by world-class investors, SecurityScorecard’s patented rating technology is used by over 25,000 organizations for self-monitoring, third-party risk management, board reporting, and cyber insurance underwriting; making all organizations more resilient by allowing them to easily find and fix cybersecurity risks across their digital footprint.

Headquartered in New York City, our culture has been recognized by Inc Magazine as a "Best Workplace,” by Crain’s NY as a "Best Places to Work in NYC," and as one of the 10 hottest SaaS startups in New York for two years in a row. Most recently, SecurityScorecard was named to Fast Company’s annual list of the World’s Most Innovative Companies for 2023 and to the Achievers 50 Most Engaged Workplaces in 2023 award recognizing “forward-thinking employers for their unwavering commitment to employee engagement.” SecurityScorecard is proud to be funded by world-class investors including Silver Lake Waterman, Moody’s, Sequoia Capital, GV and Riverwood Capital.

Why join SecurityScorecard’s Customer Success Team?

The SecurityScorecard Customer Success team is empowered by the company to help guide customers to get the most out of our great products and services. We define our Customer Success strategies, priorities and go-to-market techniques. We blaze new trails in cybersecurity thought leadership using our cybersecurity ratings and cybersecurity insights. We are a proactive CSM team that is customer centric, uses a team approach and represents the voice of the customer every day.

About The Role

The Customer Success Manager will play an important role in helping our Enterprise customers transform the way they assess security risk. The SecurityScorecard Customer Success team not only manages relationships and delights customers — they also understand our customers’ organizational goals and unique challenges to help them operationalize our platform and become more secure.

In this role, you'll own and manage customer relationships with customers, ensuring their happiness and communicating the value of our product to drive deeper, more robust engagement. You will apply your understanding of cybersecurity, third-party risk, our products, services, and best practices to proactively provide support and guidance to our customers.

What You’ll Achieve

  • Design success for a portfolio of enterprise and strategic customers throughout their lifecycle. From onboarding/implementation through upsell and renewal, you will guide your customer down the path of success every step of the way to reach their business objectives and operational goals.
  • Lead strategic conversations with customers to align our platform as a solution to their business challenges and goals with the intent to renew and expand the partnership.
  • Serve as a confident subject matter expert as it relates to the SecurityScorecard platform and the cybersecurity and third-party risk management industries.
  • Manage the gross and net retention of your portfolio; including forecasting, collaborating with regional account teams and efficient execution.
  • Work with CS and Sales VPs to continuously improve the customer journey and develop the tools and templates to ensure the CSM team employs best practices. Support fellow CSMs in solving new challenges across customers.
  • Model world class customer care and be an advocate for the voice of the customer in product and services design and deployment.

What We Need you to have

  • 3+ years of experience supporting B2B customers in a SaaS organization as a customer success manager, technical account manager or similar customer-facing role.
  • Knowledge of the tenets of Third Party Risk Management programs and cybersecurity domain experience
  • Experience working with C-level Executives that includes meetings, high level presentations, and collaborative discussions.

What We’d Like you to have

  • Experience navigating large enterprise organizations
  • Demonstrated success developing strong customer relationships
  • Proven success in new customer kickoffs, ensuring renewals, and expanding annual recurring revenue (ARR) through up-selling, and cross-selling current clients
  • Strong abilities in program and project management, balancing critical delivery tasks
  • Technical aptitude, judgment and critical decision making
  • Consultative; ability and desire to drive value for customers based on unique needs
  • Collaborative; partners across functions
  • Proactive; ability to anticipate customer needs and have solutions ready when they are
  • Intellectually curious; driven to expand cybersecurity domain and professional expertise
  • Responsive and adaptive to changing situations
  • Metrics driven; ability to translate customer needs into achievable goals and operate well in a data driven environment

Specific to each country, we offer a competitive salary, stock options, Health benefits, and unlimited PTO, parental leave, tuition reimbursements, and much more!

description:
About Us

At Zyte, we eat data for breakfast and you can eat your breakfast anywhere and work for Zyte. Founded in 2010, we are a globally distributed team of over 240 Zytans working from over 28 countries who are on a mission to enable our customers to extract the data they need to continue to innovate and grow their businesses. We believe that all businesses deserve a smooth pathway to data.

For more than a decade, Zyte has led the way in building powerful, easy-to-use tools to collect, format, and deliver web data, quickly, dependably, and at scale. Today, the data we extract helps thousands of organizations make smarter business decisions, secure competitive advantage, and drive sustainable growth. Over 3,000 companies and 1 million developers rely on our tools and services to get the data they need from the web.

About The Job

This role combines hands-on engineering with strategic leadership, focusing on delivering key indicators responsible for user happiness and efficient business operation. You will own a cost-efficient, highly scalable, high-availability system responsible for hosting and running tens of thousands of jobs simultaneously. You are expected to be a product-focused engineer, ready to radically improve the product in an always-changing environment.

We're looking for candidates who can design and build cloud systems, not just operate or maintain them.

About The Team

The Scrapy Cloud team comprises developers, data engineers, and product managers focused on building a high-performance, scalable platform. We prioritize practical engineering and collaboration, fostering a culture of innovation and continuous improvement.

Requirements

The more items you check from the following list, the better the chance we are looking for each other:

  • Experience in designing and executing experiments, including load testing, performance testing, and evaluating hardware components with basic statistical analysis.
  • Understanding of modern RDBMS architecture, concepts, and troubleshooting strategies.
  • Proficiency in Java or Python, or both.
  • Ability to fix broken builds in cross-language applications, and experience with integrating CPython with C libraries and Java.
  • Knowledge of HBase and Mesos is a plus.
  • Proficiency in Linux internals, including namespaces, containerization, process management, and memory management.
  • Ability to benchmark and integrate commodity server hardware via cloud and bare metal providers.
  • Good presentation and mentoring skills.

We are seeking candidates who can design and build cloud systems, rather than just operate or maintain them. The role is suited for those with experience beyond managing Kubernetes/OpenShift, and who have worked with load testing, hardware profiling, or program benchmarking. Candidates should have expertise beyond high-level web frameworks like Spring Boot, Django, Jersey, or Vert.x, and experience developing cloud solutions rather than only working as solution architects.

Benefits

As a new Zytan, you will:

  • Join a self-motivated, progressive, multicultural team.
  • Enjoy the flexibility to work from your preferred location.
  • Work with cutting-edge open-source technologies and tools.
  • Receive 35 days of paid holidays.
